title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the episode emotionally powerful, especially its ability to combine cute interpersonal moments with sadness and dread.
Several praised the episode's handling of its central moral questions and the contrast between ordinary school life and the harsh realities surrounding the characters.
The main character relationship was widely viewed as charming, affectionate, and compelling, with commenters enjoying their growing closeness.
Some appreciated the philosophical conflict but felt uneasy about the institutional situation and the ethical implications of sending students into combat.
A few reactions focused on how relentlessly depressing and emotionally painful the episode felt, even when its scenes were otherwise lighthearted.

opinions.point: The episode was widely viewed as very funny, especially the tense interactions involving Mio’s mother.
Many commenters enjoyed the expanded character focus and thought the group’s relationships and comedic chemistry remained strong.
The tournament setup and introduction of new competitors generated substantial excitement for future episodes.
Several commenters praised the fighting-game humor, character references, and depiction of highly committed players.
Some reactions noted that Yu’s preference for sightseeing contrasted with the group’s gaming priorities, creating a relatable but unresolved tension.
